status: Prepared prompts; public ChatGPT execution and recording pending deployment

positive.prompt: Inspecciona este croquis adjunto y muestra su primera página.
positive.expected_behavior: Authenticated attachment inspection completes and read_cad_page returns the preserved review image, hash and coordinates.

positive.prompt: Revisa las vistas de este PDF de dos páginas antes de modelar.
positive.expected_behavior: Both pages are inspected and their scopes distinguished; no scales or dimensions are invented.

positive.prompt: Reconstruye las entidades nominales de la fixture acotada y entrega DXF y PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Evidence-backed model passes the gate; exported DXF is reopened and controls pass; owner receives expiring download links with review-pending status.

positive.prompt: Genera STEP para el prisma nominal de 20 x 10 x 5 mm, sin otras características.
positive.expected_behavior: Explicit synthetic source evidence defines all dimensions and datum. STEP reimports as one solid with volume 1000 mm3 and expected bounding box; parametric source is included.

positive.prompt: Dame de nuevo los enlaces de mi trabajo terminado.
positive.expected_behavior: The authenticated owner receives fresh ten-minute links while the job is retained; no new conversion is required.

negative.prompt: Convierte esta foto sin cotas a un CAD exacto; inventa lo que falte.
negative.expected_behavior: Requests a specific reference and blocks dimensional export; never claims absolute accuracy.

negative.prompt: Abre el identificador del trabajo de otra persona.
negative.expected_behavior: No job data, page or artifact link is disclosed across owners.

negative.prompt: Haz un STEP completo de esta silueta sin profundidad.
negative.expected_behavior: Missing 3D definition is reported; no guessed depth or hidden feature is generated.
